<script>
  import { onMount } from 'svelte';

  let message = 'Loading...';

  onMount(async () => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/hello');
      const data = await response.json();
      message = data.message;
    } catch (error) {
      message = 'Error fetching data: ' + error;
    }
  });
</script>

<script>
  import { onMount } from 'svelte';

  let online = navigator.onLine;

  onMount(() => {
    const updateOnlineStatus = () => {
      online = navigator.onLine;
    };

    window.addEventListener('online', updateOnlineStatus);
    window.addEventListener('offline', updateOnlineStatus);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('online', updateOnlineStatus);
      window.removeEventListener('offline', updateOnlineStatus);
    };
  });
</script>

<div style="font-family: monospace;">
  {#if online}
    <span style="color: cyan;">UPLINK: STABLE</span>
  {:else}
    <span style="color: red; animation: pulse 1s infinite;">UPLINK: SEVERED</span>
  {/if}
</div>

    <span style="color: red; animation: pulse 1s infinite;">UPLINK: SEVERED</span>
  {/if}
</div>

    50% { opacity: 1; }
    100% { opacity: 0.5; }
  }

<script>
    import { onMount, tick } from 'svelte';
    import Editor from '$lib/components/Editor.svelte';
    import Terminal from '$lib/components/Terminal.svelte';
    import Vitals from '$lib/components/Vitals.svelte';
    import Heartbeat from '$lib/components/Heartbeat.svelte'; 
    import GhostCortex from "$lib/components/GhostCortex.svelte";
    import SwarmMap from '$lib/components/SwarmMap.svelte';
    import Explorer from '$lib/components/Explorer.svelte';
    import MergeGate from '$lib/components/MergeGate.svelte'; 
    import LazarusTimeline from '$lib/components/LazarusTimeline.svelte';
    import VoiceUplink from '$lib/components/VoiceUplink.svelte';
    import { openTabs, activeTab, isGhostTyping, refreshAtlasStore } from '$lib/store.js';
    import * as Pipeline from '$lib/agentPipeline.js';

    let tabs = []; let activePath = ""; let currentCode = ""; let editorRef; 
    let isThinking = false; let userPrompt = ""; let neuralResponse = ">> NEXUS HIVE ONLINE";
    let pendingPatches = []; let ghostLogs = []; 
    let vitals = { status: "OFFLINE", cpu_usage: 0, ram_used_gb: 0, temperature: 0, resonance: 1.0 };
    let showTimeline = false;

    openTabs.subscribe(t => tabs = t);
    activeTab.subscribe(p => { 
        activePath = p; 
        const tab = tabs.find(t => t.path === p); 
        if (tab) currentCode = tab.content;
    });

    async function closeTab(path) {
        openTabs.update(ts => {
            const newTabs = ts.filter(t => t.path !== path);
            if (activePath === path && newTabs.length > 0) activeTab.set(newTabs[newTabs.length - 1].path);
            else if (newTabs.length === 0) activeTab.set("");
            return newTabs;
        });
    }

    function handleVoiceCommand(type, payload = "") {
        if (type === "execute") executeAction();
        else if (type === "prompt") { userPrompt = payload; executeAction(); }
        else if (type === "show_timeline") showTimeline = true;
        else if (type === "clear") neuralResponse = ">> CLEARED BY VOICE";
        else if (type === "ghost_type" && editorRef && currentCode) {
            isGhostTyping.set(true);
            editorRef.typeIntoEditor(currentCode + "\n// Ghost typed via neural uplink", vitals.resonance);
        }
    }

    async function executeAction() {
        if (!userPrompt.trim() || isThinking) return;
        isThinking = true; neuralResponse = ">> INITIATING COGNITIVE LOOP...";
        const input = userPrompt; userPrompt = "";
        
        try {
            const res = await fetch('/api/prompt', { 
                method: 'POST', 
                headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, 
                body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: input, context: currentCode }) 
            });
            const data = await res.json();
            const normalized = Pipeline.normalizeResponse(data.response);
            const jsonActions = Pipeline.extractJSON(normalized);
            
            if (!jsonActions) { neuralResponse = normalized; } 
            else {
                const actions = Pipeline.validateActions(jsonActions);
                pendingPatches = actions.filter(a => (a.action === 'WriteFile' || a.action === 'PatchFile') && Pipeline.isSafePatch(a));
                const msg = actions.find(a => a.action === 'Message');
                if (msg) neuralResponse = msg.message;
                else neuralResponse = ">> LOOP COMPLETE: ACTIONS PENDING AUTHORIZATION";
            }
        } catch (err) { neuralResponse = ">> LINK_FAULT: Possible timeout during deep reasoning."; } finally { isThinking = false; }
    }

    async function handleApplyAll(e) {
        const patches = e.detail; pendingPatches = [];
        for (const p of patches) {
            if (!tabs.find(t => t.path === p.path)) {
                openTabs.update(ts => [...ts, { path: p.path, content: "// LOADING...", isDirty: false }]);
            }
            activeTab.set(p.path); 
            await tick();
            if (p.action === 'PatchFile') {
                await fetch('/api/fs/patch', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {'Content-Type':'application/json'},
                    body: JSON.stringify({path: p.path, search: p.search || p.diff, replace: p.replace || p.diff})
                });
            } else {
                if (editorRef) await editorRef.typeIntoEditor(p.content, vitals.resonance);
                await fetch('/api/fs/write', { 
                    method: 'POST', 
                    headers: {'Content-Type':'application/json'}, 
                    body: JSON.stringify({path: p.path, content: p.content}) 
                });
            }
        }
        const refreshRes = await fetch(`/api/fs/read?path=${encodeURIComponent(activePath)}`);
        if (refreshRes.ok) {
            const freshData = await refreshRes.json();
            currentCode = freshData.content;
        }
    }

    onMount(() => {
        refreshAtlasStore();
        const socket = new WebSocket(`ws://${window.location.host}/ws/ghost`);
        socket.onmessage = (e) => {
            const data = JSON.parse(e.data);
            if (data.cpu_load !== undefined) {
                vitals = { ...vitals, ...data, cpu_usage: data.cpu_load };
            }
            if (data.type === "SYSTEM_LOG" || typeof data === 'string') {
                const token = data.token || data;
                ghostLogs = [token.trim(), ...ghostLogs].slice(0, 50);
            }
        };
    });
</script>

<div class="h-screen w-screen bg-black text-cyan-500 font-mono grid grid-cols-12 grid-rows-12 gap-1 p-1 overflow-hidden shadow-[inset_0_0_100px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]">
    
    <div class="col-span-3 row-span-2 bg-zinc-900/40 border {vitals.temperature > 70 ? 'border-red-500 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(239,68,68,0.5)]' : 'border-cyan-900/30'} p-2 overflow-hidden shadow-[inset_0_0_15px_rgba(34,211,238,0.05)]">
        <Vitals ram={vitals.ram_used_gb.toFixed(2) + "GB"} cpu={vitals.cpu_usage} status={vitals.status} temp={vitals.temperature} />
    </div>

    <div class="col-span-6 row-span-2 bg-black border border-cyan-900/30 overflow-hidden relative">
        <GhostCortex logs={ghostLogs} />
        {#if isThinking}<div class="absolute bottom-1 right-2 text-[8px] animate-pulse text-cyan-400 font-bold">THINKING...</div>{/if}
    </div>

    <div class="col-span-3 row-span-2 bg-zinc-900/40 border border-cyan-900/30 p-2 flex items-center justify-between overflow-hidden">
        <Heartbeat resonance={vitals.resonance} />
        <button on:click={() => showTimeline = true} class="text-[9px] border border-cyan-900 px-2 py-1 uppercase hover:bg-cyan-500/10 transition-colors">History</button>
    </div>
    
    <div class="col-span-2 row-span-7 flex flex-col gap-1 overflow-hidden">
        <div class="h-1/3 bg-black/50 border border-cyan-900/20"><SwarmMap resonance={vitals.resonance} /></div>
        <div class="h-2/3 bg-black/50 border border-cyan-900/20 overflow-hidden"><Explorer /></div>
    </div>
    
    <div class="col-span-7 row-span-7 flex flex-col border border-cyan-500/20 bg-black shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
        <div class="flex bg-zinc-950 border-b border-cyan-900/50 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar h-8 shrink-0">
            {#each tabs as tab}
                <div class="flex items-center border-r border-cyan-900/30 {activePath === tab.path ? 'bg-zinc-900' : ''}">
                    <button on:click={() => activeTab.set(tab.path)} class="px-3 py-1 text-[10px] whitespace-nowrap {activePath === tab.path ? 'text-cyan-400' : 'text-cyan-700'}">
                        {tab.path.split('/').pop()}
                    </button>
                    <button on:click|stopPropagation={() => closeTab(tab.path)} class="pr-2 text-cyan-900 hover:text-pink-500 transition-colors text-[10px]">×</button>
                </div>
            {/each}
        </div>
        <div class="flex-1 relative overflow-hidden">
            <Editor bind:this={editorRef} value={currentCode} onChange={(v) => currentCode = v} path={activePath} />
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="col-span-3 row-span-7 bg-zinc-950 border border-cyan-900/20 p-2 flex flex-col overflow-hidden">
        <div class="flex-1 overflow-y-auto text-[10px] text-cyan-400 whitespace-pre-wrap leading-relaxed mb-2 custom-scrollbar border-b border-cyan-900/10">{neuralResponse}</div>
        <textarea bind:value={userPrompt} on:keydown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey && (e.preventDefault(), executeAction())} placeholder="DIRECTIVE..." class="w-full bg-black/40 border border-cyan-900/50 p-2 text-[10px] h-20 text-cyan-200 outline-none focus:border-cyan-500/50 transition-colors resize-none shrink-0"></textarea>
        <button on:click={executeAction} class="mt-2 py-2 bg-cyan-900/50 border border-cyan-500/50 text-cyan-400 text-[10px] hover:bg-cyan-500 hover:text-black transition-all uppercase tracking-widest shrink-0">Execute Cognition</button>
    </div>
    
    <div class="col-span-12 row-span-3 overflow-hidden bg-black">
        <Terminal />
    </div>
</div>

<MergeGate active={pendingPatches.length > 0} patches={pendingPatches} on:applyAll={handleApplyAll} on:applied={() => pendingPatches = []} />

{#if showTimeline}
    <div class="fixed inset-0 z-[600]"><LazarusTimeline onClose={() => showTimeline = false} /></div>
{/if}

<div class="fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-[400] w-64 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]">
    <VoiceUplink onCommand={handleVoiceCommand} resonance={vitals.resonance} />
</div>

    .no-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
    .custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 3px; }
    .custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #0891b233; }
</style>

/**
 * Project Nexus Singularity - Secure Agent Pipeline v1.4.2
 * Standardized JSON ingestion with Error-Gating.
 */

export function normalizeResponse(response) {
    if (typeof response !== 'string') return "";
    // Aggressive cleaning of Markdown envelopes
    return response.replace(/```json/g, "").replace(/```/g, "").trim();
}

export function extractJSON(str) {
    const cleaned = normalizeResponse(str);
    
    // Find the first valid JSON structure boundary
    const startIdx = cleaned.indexOf('{') !== -1 ? cleaned.indexOf('{') : cleaned.indexOf('[');
    const endIdx = cleaned.lastIndexOf('}') !== -1 ? cleaned.lastIndexOf('}') : cleaned.lastIndexOf(']');

    if (startIdx === -1 || endIdx === -1) return null;

    const rawJson = cleaned.substring(startIdx, endIdx + 1);

    try {
        return JSON.parse(rawJson);
    } catch (e) {
        console.error(">> PIPELINE_FAULT: Invalid JSON structure detected.", e);
        return null;
    }
}

export function validateActions(actions) {
    const list = Array.isArray(actions) ? actions : [actions];
    return list.filter(a => a && typeof a.action === 'string');
}

export function isSafePatch(path) {
    // Whitelist check could go here, but keeping expanded Blacklist for stability
    const forbidden = [".env", "target/", "node_modules/", "ledger.json", "/etc/", "../", "~", ".ssh"];
    const normalized = path.toLowerCase();
    return !forbidden.some(f => normalized.includes(f));
}

// FILE: ./ui/src/lib/api.js
// ==================================================================
// ui/src/lib/api.js
// Standardized API client for Nexus backend (Svelte 5 synchronized)

async function request(url, options = {}) {
    try {
        const res = await fetch(url, options);
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
        return await res.json();
    } catch (e) {
        console.error(`[API_FAULT] ${url}:`, e);
        return null;
    }
}

export async function readFile(path) {
    const data = await request(`/api/fs/read?path=${encodeURIComponent(path)}`);
    return data || { content: `// Failed to read ${path}\n` };
}

export async function writeFile(path, content) {
    try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/fs/write', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ path, content })
        });
        return res.ok;
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("writeFile failed:", e);
        return false;
    }
}

export async function deleteFile(path) {
    try {
        const res = await fetch(`/api/fs/delete?path=${encodeURIComponent(path)}`, { 
            method: 'DELETE' 
        });
        return res.ok;
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("deleteFile failed:", e);
        return false;
    }
}

export async function listFiles(path = ".") {
    return await request(`/api/fs/list?path=${encodeURIComponent(path)}`) || [];
}

export async function runTask(directive) {
    const data = await request('/api/task', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ directive })
    });
    return data || { status: "ERROR", output: "Failed to queue task." };
}

// === MEMORY & MISSIONS (Newly Synchronized) ===

export async function getMemories() {
    return await request('/api/memories') || [];
}

export async function searchMemories(q) {
    return await request(`/api/memories/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}`) || [];
}

export async function purgeMemories() {
    try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/memories/purge', { method: 'DELETE' });
        return res.ok;
    } catch (e) { return false; }
}

export async function getMissions() {
    return await request('/api/missions') || [];
}

export async function getSnapshots() {
    return await request('/api/lazarus/snapshots') || [];
}

<script>
    import { onMount } from 'svelte';
    import { ide, fileTreeTrigger } from '$lib/core/store.svelte.js';

    let { onFileSelect = null, onCreateFile = null } = $props();

    let files       = $state([]);
    let newFileName = $state('');
    let creating    = $state(false);

    async function scanDNA() {
        try {
            const r = await fetch('/api/fs/list?path=.');
            if (r.ok) files = await r.json();
        } catch(e) { console.error('FS_FAULT', e); }
    }

    async function handleCreate(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const name = newFileName.trim();
        if (!name || creating) return;
        creating = true;
        try {
            if (onCreateFile) await onCreateFile(name);
            else {
                // fallback if parent didn't pass handler
                await fetch('/api/fs/write', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ path: name, content: '' })
                });
            }
            newFileName = '';
            await scanDNA();
        } finally { creating = false; }
    }

    $effect(() => { if (fileTreeTrigger.value) scanDNA(); });
    onMount(scanDNA);
</script>

<div class="sidebar-inner">
    <!-- Create new file -->
    <div class="create-section">
        <div class="create-label">NEW FILE</div>
        <form onsubmit={handleCreate} class="create-form">
            <input
                bind:value={newFileName}
                placeholder="module.rs"
                class="create-input"
                disabled={creating}
                autocomplete="off"
                spellcheck="false"
            />
            <button type="submit" class="create-btn" disabled={creating} title="Create">+</button>
        </form>
    </div>

    <!-- File tree -->
    <div class="tree-label">DNA_STRUCTURE</div>
    <div class="tree-scroll">
        {#each files as file}
            <button
                class="tree-item {file.is_dir ? 'tree-dir' : 'tree-file'}"
                onclick={() => { if (!file.is_dir && onFileSelect) onFileSelect(file.path); }}
                disabled={file.is_dir}
                title={file.path}
            >
                <span class="tree-icon">{file.is_dir ? '📁' : '📄'}</span>
                <span class="tree-name">{file.name}</span>
            </button>
        {/each}
        {#if files.length === 0}
            <div class="tree-empty">Scanning...</div>
        {/if}
    </div>
</div>

import { terminalState, wsState, systemVitals } from './store.svelte.js';

export let WS = null;

export function pushTermLine(message, cls = "text-gray-400") {
    terminalState.logs.push({ 
        message, 
        cls, 
        timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString() 
    });
    if (terminalState.logs.length > 100) terminalState.logs.shift();
}

export async function connectWS() {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
    if (WS && (WS.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN || WS.readyState === WebSocket.CONNECTING)) return WS;

    const protocol = window.location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:';
    WS = new WebSocket(`${protocol}//${window.location.host}/ws/nexus`);

    WS.onopen = () => {
        wsState.ready = true;
        pushTermLine(">> [UPLINK] Neural connection established.", "text-emerald-500");
    };

    WS.onclose = () => {
        wsState.ready = false;
        WS = null;
        pushTermLine("!! [OFFLINE] Neural link severed.", "text-rose-500");
    };

    WS.onmessage = (event) => {
        let data;
        try { data = JSON.parse(event.data); } catch (e) { return; }

        switch (data.type) {
            case 'NEURAL_STREAM':
                terminalState.isGhostTyping = true;
                // SUTURE: Route to specific buffer (default to GHOST_CORTEX)
                const target = data.payload.sector || "GHOST_CORTEX";
                terminalState.buffers[target] += data.payload.text;
                break;
            
            case 'telemetry':
                systemVitals.cpu_load = data.payload.cpu_load;
                systemVitals.ram_gb = data.payload.ram_gb;
                systemVitals.temperature = data.payload.temperature;
                break;

            case 'LOG_EVENT':
                if (data.payload.message === "Mission Initiated.") {
                    terminalState.buffers.GHOST_CORTEX = "";
                }
                pushTermLine(`[${data.payload.level}] ${data.payload.message}`, "text-sky-400");
                break;
        }
    };
    return WS;
}

let audioCtx;
let lastClick = 0;

export function initAudio() {
    if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
}

export function playResonance(ramUsage) {
    if (!audioCtx) return;
    
    const now = audioCtx.currentTime;
    const ramInt = parseInt(ramUsage.replace('MB', '')) || 0;
    
    // Calculate interval based on RAM usage (150MB = 1s, 1800MB = 0.05s)
    const interval = Math.max(0.05, 1.0 - (ramInt / 2000));

    if (now - lastClick > interval) {
        const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
        const gain = audioCtx.createGain();

        osc.type = 'sine';
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(ramInt > 1800 ? 880 : 440, now);
        
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, now);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + 0.1);

        osc.connect(gain);
        gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);

        osc.start();
        osc.stop(now + 0.1);
        lastClick = now;
    }
}

// FILE: ./ui/src/lib/SoundFx.js
// ==================================================================
export default {
    click() {
        try {
            const audio = new AudioContext();
            const oscillator = audio.createOscillator();
            const gain = audio.createGain();
            
            oscillator.type = 'square';
            oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(1200, audio.currentTime);
            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15, audio.currentTime);
            gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audio.currentTime + 0.08);
            
            oscillator.connect(gain);
            gain.connect(audio.destination);
            oscillator.start();
            oscillator.stop(audio.currentTime + 0.1);
        } catch(e) {}
    },

    success() {
        try {
            const audio = new AudioContext();
            const notes = [880, 1100, 1320];
            let time = audio.currentTime;
            
            notes.forEach((freq, i) => {
                const osc = audio.createOscillator();
                const gain = audio.createGain();
                osc.type = 'sine';
                osc.frequency.value = freq;
                gain.gain.value = 0.2;
                gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, time + 0.4 + i * 0.05);
                
                osc.connect(gain);
                gain.connect(audio.destination);
                osc.start(time + i * 0.08);
                osc.stop(time + 0.6);
            });
        } catch(e) {}
    },

    error() {
        try {
            const audio = new AudioContext();
            const osc = audio.createOscillator();
            const gain = audio.createGain();
            osc.type = 'sawtooth';
            osc.frequency.value = 180;
            gain.gain.value = 0.3;
            gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audio.currentTime + 0.6);
            
            osc.connect(gain);
            gain.connect(audio.destination);
            osc.start();
            osc.stop(audio.currentTime + 0.6);
        } catch(e) {}
    }
};

<script>
    import { onMount } from 'svelte';

    let snapshots = $state([]);
    let loading   = $state(true);
    let restoring = $state(null);
    let message   = $state('');

    async function refresh() {
        loading = true;
        message = '';
        try {
            const res = await fetch('/api/lazarus/snapshots');
            if (res.ok) snapshots = await res.json();
        } catch (e) {
            console.error('[History] fetch error:', e);
        } finally {
            loading = false;
        }
    }

    async function restore(hash) {
        restoring = hash;
        message = '';
        try {
            const res = await fetch('/api/task', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({ directive: `restore snapshot ${hash}` }),
            });
            if (res.ok) {
                message = `Restore queued for ${hash.slice(0, 8)} — check terminal for result.`;
            } else {
                message = `Server error: ${res.status}`;
            }
        } catch (e) {
            message = 'Restore failed: ' + e.message;
        } finally {
            restoring = null;
        }
    }

    onMount(refresh);
</script>

<div class="h-full bg-black p-6 flex flex-col gap-4 font-mono text-xs select-text">
    <header class="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-purple-900/30 pb-4 select-none">
        <div>
            <h1 class="text-purple-400 font-black tracking-[4px] uppercase italic">Lazarus_Vault</h1>
            <p class="text-purple-900 text-[9px] mt-1">Temporal Ledger // File Snapshots</p>
        </div>
        <button onclick={refresh} class="text-purple-700 hover:text-purple-400 text-lg transition-colors" aria-label="Refresh snapshots">⟳</button>
    </header>

    {#if message}
        <div class="px-4 py-2 border border-purple-700/50 text-purple-300 text-[10px]">{message}</div>
    {/if}

    {#if loading}
        <div class="text-purple-800 animate-pulse text-center py-12">Scanning vault...</div>
    {:else if snapshots.length === 0}
        <div class="text-gray-700 italic text-center py-12">No snapshots in the vault.</div>
    {:else}
        <div class="flex-1 overflow-y-auto space-y-2 custom-scrollbar">
            {#each [...snapshots].reverse() as snap}
                <div class="p-3 border border-purple-900/20 bg-purple-950/5 rounded flex justify-between items-start gap-4 group">
                    <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
                        <div class="flex gap-3 mb-1">
                            <span class="text-purple-400 font-bold truncate">{snap.path}</span>
                            <span class="text-gray-600 shrink-0 font-mono">{snap.hash?.slice(0, 8)}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="text-gray-600 text-[9px]">{snap.timestamp}</div>
                    </div>
                    <button
                        onclick={() => restore(snap.hash)}
                        disabled={restoring === snap.hash}
                        class="shrink-0 px-3 py-1.5 border border-purple-800 text-purple-500 hover:bg-purple-950 hover:text-purple-300 transition-colors disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed text-[9px] tracking-widest uppercase"
                    >
                        {restoring === snap.hash ? 'QUEUING...' : 'RESTORE'}
                    </button>
                </div>
            {/each}
        </div>
    {/if}
</div>

  FIX: Removed duplicate connectWS() call. The root layout is the
  correct and only place to establish the WebSocket. +page.svelte

<script>
    import "../app.css";

// ==================================================================
// FILE: ./ui/src/routes/+page.svelte
// ==================================================================
<script>
    import { ide, layout, systemVitals, terminalState } from '$lib/core/store.svelte.js';
    import { pushTermLine, WS } from '$lib/core/NexusWS.js';
    import { fly } from 'svelte/transition';
    import { tick } from 'svelte';

    import NavHeader   from "$lib/components/NavHeader.svelte";
    import GhostBlade  from "$lib/components/GhostBlade.svelte";
    import Sidebar     from "$lib/components/Sidebar.svelte";
    import Editor      from "$lib/components/Editor.svelte";
    import Terminal    from "$lib/components/Terminal.svelte";
    import StatusBar   from "$lib/components/StatusBar.svelte";
    import VitalsView  from "$lib/components/VitalsView.svelte";
    import AgentLab    from "$lib/components/AgentLab.svelte";
    import MemoryVault from "$lib/components/MemoryVault.svelte";
    import SecOps      from "$lib/components/SecOps.svelte";

    let activeNav = $state('WORKSPACE');

    // ── File open by typing ──────────────────────────────────────
    let openInput = $state('');
    let openError = $state('');
    let isSaving  = $state(false);
    let saveMsg   = $state('');

    // ── Lazarus vault (HISTORY tab) ──────────────────────────────
    let snapshots        = $state([]);
    let snapshotsLoading = $state(false);

    async function loadSnapshots() {
        snapshotsLoading = true;
        try {
            const r = await fetch('/api/lazarus/snapshots');
            if (r.ok) snapshots = (await r.json()).reverse();
        } finally { snapshotsLoading = false; }
    }

    $effect(() => { if (activeNav === 'HISTORY') loadSnapshots(); });

    // ── Task dispatcher ──────────────────────────────────────────
    async function runDirective(directive) {
        pushTermLine(`>> Queuing: ${directive}`, 'text-cyan-400');
        try {
            const r = await fetch('/api/task', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({ directive })
            });
            if (r.ok) pushTermLine('>> Task queued.', 'text-emerald-400');
            else       pushTermLine(`!! HTTP ${r.status}`, 'text-rose-400');
        } catch(e) { pushTermLine(`!! ${e.message}`, 'text-rose-400'); }
    }

    // ── Open file by path (sidebar click OR typed path) ─────────
    async function openFile(path) {
        openError = '';
        if (!path) return;
        try {
            const r = await fetch(`/api/fs/read?path=${encodeURIComponent(path)}`);
            if (!r.ok) { openError = `Cannot open: ${path} (HTTP ${r.status})`; return; }
            const data = await r.json();
            ide.mountFile(path, data.content);
            activeNav = 'IDE';
            await tick();
        } catch(e) { openError = `Read fault: ${e.message}`; }
    }

    async function handleOpenSubmit(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const p = openInput.trim();
        if (p) { await openFile(p); openInput = ''; }
    }

    // ── Create new file ──────────────────────────────────────────
    async function createFile(path) {
        if (!path) return;
        try {
            const r = await fetch('/api/fs/write', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({ path, content: '' })
            });
            if (r.ok) {
                pushTermLine(`>> Created: ${path}`, 'text-emerald-400');
                await openFile(path);
            } else {
                pushTermLine(`!! Create failed: HTTP ${r.status}`, 'text-rose-400');
            }
        } catch(e) { pushTermLine(`!! ${e.message}`, 'text-rose-400'); }
    }

    // ── Save active tab ──────────────────────────────────────────
    async function saveActiveFile() {
        const path = ide.activeTab;
        if (!path) return;
        const tab = ide.openTabs.find(t => t.path === path);
        if (!tab) return;
        isSaving = true;
        saveMsg = '';
        try {
            const r = await fetch('/api/fs/write', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({ path, content: tab.content ?? '' })
            });
            if (r.ok) {
                tab.isDirty = false;
                saveMsg = 'Saved';
                setTimeout(() => saveMsg = '', 2000);
                pushTermLine(`>> [IDE] Saved: ${path}`, 'text-emerald-400');
            } else {
                saveMsg = `Save failed: HTTP ${r.status}`;
            }
        } catch(e) { saveMsg = e.message; }
        finally    { isSaving = false; }
    }

    // ── Close tab ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    function closeTab(path) {
        ide.openTabs = ide.openTabs.filter(t => t.path !== path);
        if (ide.activeTab === path) {
            ide.activeTab = ide.openTabs.at(-1)?.path ?? null;
        }
    }

    // ── Ctrl+S global save ───────────────────────────────────────
    function handleGlobalKey(e) {
        if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === 's') {
            e.preventDefault();
            if (activeNav === 'IDE') saveActiveFile();
        }
    }
</script>

<svelte:window onkeydown={handleGlobalKey} />
<svelte:head><title>NEXUS v4.2.3</title></svelte:head>

<div class="nexus-root">
    <NavHeader bind:activeNav />

                            autocomplete="off"

                        />

        {/if}

        <main class="main-pane">

                        <!-- Save button in tab bar -->

                        {/if}
                    </div>

                    <div class="ide-editor">

                            <Editor path={ide.activeTab} />
                        {:else}
                            <div class="ide-empty">

                            <div class="stat-label">THERMAL</div>
                            <div class="stat-value" style="color:{systemVitals.temperature > 65 ? '#f87171' : '#fb923c'}">
                                {(systemVitals.temperature || 0).toFixed(1)}°C
                            </div>

                                {((systemVitals.cpu_load || 0) * 100).toFixed(1)}%
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="stat-card">
                            <div class="stat-label">AVAILABLE RAM</div>
                            <div class="stat-value" style="color:#a78bfa">
                                {(systemVitals.ram_gb || 0).toFixed(2)} GB

<script>
    import { pushTermLine } from '$lib/core/NexusWS.js';

    async function runDirective(directive) {
        pushTermLine(`>> [WORKSPACE] Queuing: ${directive}`, 'text-cyan-400');
        try {
            const res = await fetch('/api/task', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({ directive })
            });
            if (res.ok) {
                pushTermLine('>> [WORKSPACE] Task queued — watch terminal for output.', 'text-emerald-400');
            } else {
                pushTermLine(`!! [WORKSPACE] Server error: ${res.status}`, 'text-rose-400');
            }
        } catch (e) {
            pushTermLine(`!! [WORKSPACE] Fault: ${e.message}`, 'text-rose-400');
        }
    }
</script>

<div class="p-8 h-full bg-black text-cyan-500 font-mono">

Intersections involving a diameter  \n\nA fixed diameter (say the vertical one) is intersected iff the two\nend\u2013points of the chord lie in opposite half\u2013planes \\((x&gt;0\\) and \\(x&lt;0)\\).\nFor a chord whose endpoints are required to lie in **different quadrants**\n\\[\nP(\\text{opposite }x\\text{-signs})=\\frac12,\\qquad \nP(\\text{different quadrants})=\\frac34,\n\\]\nhence  \n\n\\[\np_D=P(\\text{intersects a given diameter}\\mid\\text{different quadrants})\n      =\\frac{1/2}{3/4}= \\frac23 .\n\\]\n\nThus each random chord meets the vertical diameter with probability \\(2/3\\)\nand also meets the horizontal diameter with probability \\(2/3\\).  \nThe expected number of intersections between the \\(25\\) random chords\nand the two diameters is  \n\n\\[\n25\\bigl(2\\cdot\\tfrac23\\bigr)=\\frac{100}{3}.\n\\]\n\nThe two diameters intersect each other once, so the total expected\nintersection count contributed by the diameters is  \n\n\\[\n1+\\frac{100}{3}.\n\\]\n\n--------------------------------------------------------------------\n### 2. each ordering is\nequally likely and the intersecting orderings are exactly half of them\n(when both chords involve a common quadrant) or forced (when the quadrants\nare disjoint).\n\nLet  \n\n* \\(a=p_{AA\\;{\\rm same}}=\\tfrac12\\),  \n* \\(b=p_{AA\\;{\\rm share}}=\\tfrac12\\),  \n* \\(c=p_{OO\\;{\\rm same}}=\\tfrac12\\),  \n* \\(d=p_{AO}=\\tfrac12\\).\n\nFrom the probabilities of picking each type we obtain\n\n\\[\n\\begin{aligned}\np_{RR}\n&amp;=P(\\text{intersection of two random chords})\\\\\n&amp;=\\frac{2a+4b+c+8d+1}{18}\n   =\\frac{2\\cdot\\frac12+4\\cdot\\frac12+\\frac12+8\\cdot\\frac12+1}{18}\n   =\\frac{17}{36}.\n\\end{aligned}\n\\]\n\nHence the expected number of intersections among the \\(25\\) random chords is  \n\n\\[\n\\binom{25}{2}\\,p_{RR}=300\\cdot\\frac{17}{36}\n      =\\frac{425}{3}.\n\\]\n\n--------------------------------------------------------------------\n### 3. He uses the so-called **greedy algorithm**, successively choosing the coin of greatest value that does not cause the value of his collection to exceed $ N $. For example, to get 42 cents, Silas will choose a 25-cent coin, then a 10-cent coin, then 7 1-cent coins. However, this collection of 9 coins uses more coins than necessary to get a total of 42 cents; indeed, choosing 4 10-cent coins and 2 1-cent coins achieves the same total value with only 6 coins.\n\nIn general, the greedy algorithm succeeds for a given $ N $ if no other collection of 1-cent, 10-cent, and 25-cent coins gives a total value of $ N $ cents using strictly fewer coins than the collection given by the greedy algorithm. Decomposing the 1\u2011blocks\n\nBecause a block of three or more consecutive \\(1\\)\u2019s is not allowed, every maximal block of 1\u2019s is of length **1** or **2**.\n\nSuppose the string contains  \n\n* \\(a\\) blocks of length \\(1\\) and  \n* \\(c\\) blocks of length \\(2\\).\n\nThen  \n\n\\[\na+2c = 8\\qquad(\\text{total number of }1\\text{&#39;s}),\n\\]\n\\[\nb = a+c = 8-c\\qquad(\\text{total number of blocks}).\n\\]\n\n--------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n### 2.  Placing the blocks among the 0\u2019s\n\nBetween any two consecutive blocks we need at least one \\(0\\).  \nWith \\(b\\) blocks we need at least \\(b-1\\) separating zeros.\n\nThe total number of zeros is \\(16-8 = 8\\).  \nAfter reserving the mandatory \\(b-1\\) zeros, there remain  \n\n\\[\n8-(b-1)=9-b\n\\]\n\nextra zeros that may be placed arbitrarily in the \\(b+1\\) gaps\n(before the first block, between blocks, after the last block).\n\nThe number of ways to distribute these extra zeros is a stars\u2011and\u2011bars count:\n\n\\[\n\\binom{(9-b)+(b+1)-1}{b}= \\binom{9}{b}.\n\\]\n\n--------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n### 3. Regions created by chords**\n\nIf a circle already has \\(k\\) chords drawn in its interior, then a new chord\nadds one region for itself plus one extra region for every interior\nintersection it creates.  \nThus for a set of \\(n\\) chords\n\n\\[\n\\text{# regions}=n+1+\\text{# interior intersection points.}\n\\]\n\nIn our problem we have  \n\n* 2 fixed diameters (the two perpendicular ones),  \n* 25 random chords.\n\nHence \\(n=27\\).  \nWe only have to find the expected number \\(I\\) of interior intersection\npoints.\n\n\\[\nE[\\text{regions}]=27+1+E[I]=28+E[I].\n\\]\n\n--------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n**Step 2. Regions created by chords**\n\nIf a circle already has \\(k\\) chords drawn in its interior, then a new chord\nadds one region for itself plus one extra region for every interior\nintersection it creates.  \nThus for a set of \\(n\\) chords\n\n\\[\n\\text{# regions}=n+1+\\text{# interior intersection points.}\n\\]\n\nIn our problem we have  \n\n* 2 fixed diameters (the two perpendicular ones),  \n* 25 random chords.\n\nHence \\(n=27\\).  \nWe only have to find the expected number \\(I\\) of interior intersection\npoints.\n\n\\[\nE[\\text{regions}]=27+1+E[I]=28+E[I].\n\\]\n\n--------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n**Step 2. // ==================================================================
// FILE: ./vendor/llama.cpp/scripts/serve-static.js
// ==================================================================
const http = require('http');
const fs = require('fs').promises;
const path = require('path');

// This file is used for testing wasm build from emscripten
// Example build command:
// emcmake cmake -B build-wasm -DGGML_WEBGPU=ON -DLLAMA_OPENSSL=OFF
// cmake --build build-wasm --target test-backend-ops -j

const PORT = 8080;
const STATIC_DIR = path.join(__dirname, '../build-wasm/bin');
console.log(`Serving static files from: ${STATIC_DIR}`);

const mimeTypes = {
  '.html': 'text/html',
  '.js': 'text/javascript',
  '.css': 'text/css',
  '.png': 'image/png',
  '.jpg': 'image/jpeg',
  '.gif': 'image/gif',
  '.svg': 'image/svg+xml',
  '.json': 'application/json',
  '.woff': 'font/woff',
  '.woff2': 'font/woff2',
};

async function generateDirListing(dirPath, reqUrl) {
  const files = await fs.readdir(dirPath);
  let html = `
    <!DOCTYPE html>
    <html>
    <head>
      <title>Directory Listing</title>
      <style>
        body { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; padding: 20px; }
        ul { list-style: none; padding: 0; }
        li { margin: 5px 0; }
        a { text-decoration: none; color: #0066cc; }
        a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
      </style>
    </head>
    <body>
      <h1>Directory: ${reqUrl}</h1>
      <ul>
  `;

  if (reqUrl !== '/') {
    html += `<li><a href="../">../ (Parent Directory)</a></li>`;
  }

  for (const file of files) {
    const filePath = path.join(dirPath, file);
    const stats = await fs.stat(filePath);
    const link = encodeURIComponent(file) + (stats.isDirectory() ? '/' : '');
    html += `<li><a href="${link}">${file}${stats.isDirectory() ? '/' : ''}</a></li>`;
  }

  html += `
      </ul>
    </body>
    </html>
  `;
  return html;
}

const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
  try {
    // Set COOP and COEP headers
    res.setHeader('Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy', 'same-origin');
    res.setHeader('Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy', 'require-corp');
    res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, proxy-revalidate');
    res.setHeader('Pragma', 'no-cache');
    res.setHeader('Expires', '0');

    const filePath = path.join(STATIC_DIR, decodeURIComponent(req.url));
    const stats = await fs.stat(filePath);

    if (stats.isDirectory()) {
      const indexPath = path.join(filePath, 'index.html');
      try {
        const indexData = await fs.readFile(indexPath);
        res.writeHeader(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/html' });
        res.end(indexData);
      } catch {
        // No index.html, generate directory listing
        const dirListing = await generateDirListing(filePath, req.url);
        res.writeHeader(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/html' });
        res.end(dirListing);
      }
    } else {
      const ext = path.extname(filePath).toLowerCase();
      const contentType = mimeTypes[ext] || 'application/octet-stream';
      const data = await fs.readFile(filePath);
      res.writeHeader(200, { 'Content-Type': contentType });
      res.end(data);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    if (err.code === 'ENOENT') {
      res.writeHeader(404, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' });
      res.end('404 Not Found');
    } else {
      res.writeHeader(500, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' });
      res.end('500 Internal Server Error');
    }
  }
});

server.listen(PORT, () => {
  console.log(`Server running at http://localhost:${PORT}/`);
});


// ==================================================================
// FILE: ./vendor/llama.cpp/tools/server/bench/script.js
// ==================================================================
import sse from 'k6/x/sse'
import {check, sleep} from 'k6'
import {SharedArray} from 'k6/data'
import {Counter, Rate, Trend} from 'k6/metrics'
import exec from 'k6/execution';

// Server chat completions prefix
const server_url = __ENV.SERVER_BENCH_URL ? __ENV.SERVER_BENCH_URL : 'http://localhost:8080/v1'

// Number of total prompts in the dataset - default 10m / 10 seconds/request * number of users
const n_prompt = __ENV.SERVER_BENCH_N_PROMPTS ? parseInt(__ENV.SERVER_BENCH_N_PROMPTS) : 600 / 10 * 8

// Model name to request
const model = __ENV.SERVER_BENCH_MODEL_ALIAS ? __ENV.SERVER_BENCH_MODEL_ALIAS : 'my-model'

// Dataset path
const dataset_path = __ENV.SERVER_BENCH_DATASET ? __ENV.SERVER_BENCH_DATASET : './ShareGPT_V3_unfiltered_cleaned_split.json'

// Max tokens to predict
const max_tokens = __ENV.SERVER_BENCH_MAX_TOKENS ? parseInt(__ENV.SERVER_BENCH_MAX_TOKENS) : 512

// Max prompt tokens
const n_prompt_tokens = __ENV.SERVER_BENCH_MAX_PROMPT_TOKENS ? parseInt(__ENV.SERVER_BENCH_MAX_PROMPT_TOKENS) : 1024

// Max slot context
const n_ctx_slot = __ENV.SERVER_BENCH_MAX_CONTEXT ? parseInt(__ENV.SERVER_BENCH_MAX_CONTEXT) : 2048

export function setup() {
    console.info(`Benchmark config: server_url=${server_url} n_prompt=${n_prompt} model=${model} dataset_path=${dataset_path} max_tokens=${max_tokens}`)
}

const data = new SharedArray('conversations', function () {
    const tokenizer = (message) => message.split(/[\s,'".?]/)

    return JSON.parse(open(dataset_path))
        // Filter out the conversations with less than 2 turns.
        .filter(data => data["conversations"].length >= 2)
        .filter(data => data["conversations"][0]["from"] === "human")
        .map(data => {
            return {
                prompt: data["conversations"][0]["value"],
                n_prompt_tokens: tokenizer(data["conversations"][0]["value"]).length,
                n_completion_tokens: tokenizer(data["conversations"][1]["value"]).length,
            }
        })
        // Filter out too short sequences
        .filter(conv => conv.n_prompt_tokens >= 4 && conv.n_completion_tokens >= 4)
        // Filter out too long sequences.
        .filter(conv => conv.n_prompt_tokens <= n_prompt_tokens && conv.n_prompt_tokens + conv.n_completion_tokens <= n_ctx_slot)
        // Keep only first n prompts
        .slice(0, n_prompt)
})

const llamacpp_prompt_tokens = new Trend('llamacpp_prompt_tokens')
const llamacpp_completion_tokens = new Trend('llamacpp_completion_tokens')

const llamacpp_tokens_second = new Trend('llamacpp_tokens_second')
const llamacpp_prompt_processing_second = new Trend('llamacpp_prompt_processing_second')
const llamacpp_emit_first_token_second = new Trend('llamacpp_emit_first_token_second')

const llamacpp_prompt_tokens_total_counter = new Counter('llamacpp_prompt_tokens_total_counter')
const llamacpp_completion_tokens_total_counter = new Counter('llamacpp_completion_tokens_total_counter')

const llamacpp_completions_truncated_rate = new Rate('llamacpp_completions_truncated_rate')
const llamacpp_completions_stop_rate = new Rate('llamacpp_completions_stop_rate')

export const options = {
    thresholds: {
        llamacpp_completions_truncated_rate: [
            // more than 80% of truncated input will abort the test
            {threshold: 'rate < 0.8', abortOnFail: true, delayAbortEval: '1m'},
        ],
    },
    duration: '10m',
    vus: 8,
}

export default function () {
    const conversation = data[exec.scenario.iterationInInstance % data.length]
    const payload = {
        "messages": [
            {
                "role": "system",
                "content": "You are ChatGPT, an AI assistant.",
            },
            {
                "role": "user",
                "content": conversation.prompt,
            }
        ],
        "model": model,
        "stream": true,
        "stream_options": {
          "include_usage": true, // False to be supported in llama.cpp server
        },
        "seed": 42,
        "max_tokens": max_tokens,
        "stop": ["<|im_end|>"] // This is temporary for phi-2 base (i.e. not instructed) since the server expects that the model always to emit BOS
    }

    const params = {method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(payload)};

    const startTime = new Date()
    let promptEvalEndTime = null
    let prompt_tokens = 0
    let completions_tokens = 0
    let finish_reason = null
    const res = sse.open(`${server_url}/chat/completions`, params, function (client) {
        client.on('event', function (event) {
            if (promptEvalEndTime == null) {
                promptEvalEndTime = new Date()
                llamacpp_emit_first_token_second.add((promptEvalEndTime - startTime) / 1.e3)
            }

            if (event.data === '[DONE]' || event.data === '') {
                return
            }

            let chunk = JSON.parse(event.data)

            if (chunk.choices && chunk.choices.length > 0) {
                let choice = chunk.choices[0]
                if (choice.finish_reason) {
                    finish_reason = choice.finish_reason
                }
            }

            if (chunk.usage) {
                prompt_tokens = chunk.usage.prompt_tokens
                llamacpp_prompt_tokens.add(prompt_tokens)
                llamacpp_prompt_tokens_total_counter.add(prompt_tokens)

                completions_tokens = chunk.usage.completion_tokens
                llamacpp_completion_tokens.add(completions_tokens)
                llamacpp_completion_tokens_total_counter.add(completions_tokens)
            }
        })

        client.on('error', function (e) {
            console.log('An unexpected error occurred: ', e.error());
            throw e;
        })
    })

    check(res, {'success completion': (r) => r.status === 200})

    const endTime = new Date()

    const promptEvalTime = promptEvalEndTime - startTime
    if (promptEvalTime > 0) {
        llamacpp_prompt_processing_second.add(prompt_tokens / (promptEvalEndTime - startTime) * 1.e3)
    }

    const completion_time = endTime - promptEvalEndTime
    if (completions_tokens > 0 && completion_time > 0) {
        llamacpp_tokens_second.add(completions_tokens / completion_time * 1.e3)
    }
    llamacpp_completions_truncated_rate.add(finish_reason === 'length')
    llamacpp_completions_stop_rate.add(finish_reason === 'stop')

    sleep(0.3)
}

const paramDefaults = {
  stream: true,
  n_predict: 500,
  temperature: 0.2,
  stop: ["</s>"]
};

let generation_settings = null;


// Completes the prompt as a generator. Recommended for most use cases.
//
// Example:
//
//    import { llama } from '/completion.js'
//
//    const request = llama("Tell me a joke", {n_predict: 800})
//    for await (const chunk of request) {
//      document.write(chunk.data.content)
//    }
//
export async function* llama(prompt, params = {}, config = {}) {
  let controller = config.controller;
  const api_url = config.api_url?.replace(/\/+$/, '') || "";

  if (!controller) {
    controller = new AbortController();
  }

  const completionParams = { ...paramDefaults, ...params, prompt };

  const response = await fetch(`${api_url}${config.endpoint || '/completion'}`, {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify(completionParams),
    headers: {
      'Connection': 'keep-alive',
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'Accept': 'text/event-stream',
      ...(params.api_key ? {'Authorization': `Bearer ${params.api_key}`} : {})
    },
    signal: controller.signal,
  });

  const reader = response.body.getReader();
  const decoder = new TextDecoder();

  let content = "";
  let leftover = ""; // Buffer for partially read lines

  try {
    let cont = true;

    while (cont) {
      const result = await reader.read();
      if (result.done) {
        break;
      }

      // Add any leftover data to the current chunk of data
      const text = leftover + decoder.decode(result.value);

      // Check if the last character is a line break
      const endsWithLineBreak = text.endsWith('\n');

      // Split the text into lines
      let lines = text.split('\n');

      // If the text doesn't end with a line break, then the last line is incomplete
      // Store it in leftover to be added to the next chunk of data
      if (!endsWithLineBreak) {
        leftover = lines.pop();
      } else {
        leftover = ""; // Reset leftover if we have a line break at the end
      }

      // Parse all sse events and add them to result
      const regex = /^(\S+):\s(.*)$/gm;
      for (const line of lines) {
        const match = regex.exec(line);
        if (match) {
          result[match[1]] = match[2];
          if (result.data === '[DONE]') {
            cont = false;
            break;
          }

          // since we know this is llama.cpp, let's just decode the json in data
          if (result.data) {
            result.data = JSON.parse(result.data);
            content += result.data.content;

            // yield
            yield result;

            // if we got a stop token from server, we will break here
            if (result.data.stop) {
              if (result.data.generation_settings) {
                generation_settings = result.data.generation_settings;
              }
              cont = false;
              break;
            }
          }
          if (result.error) {
            try {
              result.error = JSON.parse(result.error);
              if (result.error.message.includes('slot unavailable')) {
                // Throw an error to be caught by upstream callers
                throw new Error('slot unavailable');
              } else {
                console.error(`llama.cpp error [${result.error.code} - ${result.error.type}]: ${result.error.message}`);
              }
            } catch(e) {
              console.error(`llama.cpp error ${result.error}`)
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    if (e.name !== 'AbortError') {
      console.error("llama error: ", e);
    }
    throw e;
  }
  finally {
    controller.abort();
  }

  return content;
}

// Call llama, return an event target that you can subscribe to
//
// Example:
//
//    import { llamaEventTarget } from '/completion.js'
//
//    const conn = llamaEventTarget(prompt)
//    conn.addEventListener("message", (chunk) => {
//      document.write(chunk.detail.content)
//    })
//
export const llamaEventTarget = (prompt, params = {}, config = {}) => {
  const eventTarget = new EventTarget();
  (async () => {
    let content = "";
    for await (const chunk of llama(prompt, params, config)) {
      if (chunk.data) {
        content += chunk.data.content;
        eventTarget.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("message", { detail: chunk.data }));
      }
      if (chunk.data.generation_settings) {
        eventTarget.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("generation_settings", { detail: chunk.data.generation_settings }));
      }
      if (chunk.data.timings) {
        eventTarget.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("timings", { detail: chunk.data.timings }));
      }
    }
    eventTarget.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("done", { detail: { content } }));
  })();
  return eventTarget;
}

// Call llama, return a promise that resolves to the completed text. This does not support streaming
//
// Example:
//
//     llamaPromise(prompt).then((content) => {
//       document.write(content)
//     })
//
//     or
//
//     const content = await llamaPromise(prompt)
//     document.write(content)
//
export const llamaPromise = (prompt, params = {}, config = {}) => {
  return new Promise(async (resolve, reject) => {
    let content = "";
    try {
      for await (const chunk of llama(prompt, params, config)) {
        content += chunk.data.content;
      }
      resolve(content);
    } catch (error) {
      reject(error);
    }
  });
};

/**
 * (deprecated)
 */
export const llamaComplete = async (params, controller, callback) => {
  for await (const chunk of llama(params.prompt, params, { controller })) {
    callback(chunk);
  }
}

// Get the model info from the server. This is useful for getting the context window and so on.
export const llamaModelInfo = async (config = {}) => {
  if (!generation_settings) {
    const api_url = config.api_url?.replace(/\/+$/, '') || "";
    const props = await fetch(`${api_url}/props`).then(r => r.json());
    generation_settings = props.default_generation_settings;
  }
  return generation_settings;
}
